thread.title: Streaming Music Leader Spotify Notches Record High On Bullish Views

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Streaming Music Leader Spotify Notches Record High On Bullish Views
text:
Spotify Technology ( SPOT ) shares hit an all-time high on Wednesday after two Wall Street firms issued positive reports on the streaming music leader.
X Evercore ISI raised its price target on Spotify stock to 200 from 190 and reiterated an outperform rating. Nomura Instinet initiated coverage of Spotify with a buy rating and price target of 210.
Spotify rose 1.1% to close at 182.35 on the stock market today . In intraday trading, it hit a record high of 183.24. Spotify went public on April 3, ending its first day at 149.01.
Evercore analyst Anthony DiClemente raised his estimates for Spotify users and subscribers in the second quarter. Based on that, he expects Spotify to deliver strong revenue growth of 28.5% year over year in the second quarter.

"We continue to think Spotify fundamentals are analogous to those of Netflix ( NFLX ), despite business model differences, as both are global, dominant subscription streaming platforms," DiClemente said.
He believes Spotify ended the June quarter with 83 million paying users and 180 million total users, including its ad-supported service tier.
Spotify ended the March quarter with 75 million paying subscribers and 170 million total active users. Its biggest rival is the Apple Music service from Apple ( AAPL ), which has been gaining fast in subscribers.
While Spotify has a comfortable lead worldwide, Apple Music reportedly has passed it in subscribers in the U.S. market, DiClemente said.
"The key debate surrounding Spotify's long-term potential revolves around its evolving relationship with (the music) labels," he said. "Bulls contend that Spotify stands to disrupt the current paradigm and should see gross margins improve over time. Bears are concerned that given the concentrated supplier power of the major labels, that Spotify's long-term profit potential is limited."
Nomura Instinet analyst Mark Kelley thinks Spotify has solidified its leadership position.
"We believe that Spotify is the best-positioned independent music streaming provider globally and that it stands to benefit from continued industry growth," Kelley said in a report. "Spotify has become the market leader in streaming music despite intense competition from the large tech platforms. We also believe the advertising business will be a greater contributor over time."
